description: Per-room stays-solved mode for Dungeons/room_state.asm. Build data: Scripts/Generate/generate_room_state_table.py writes Dungeons/generated/room_state_table.asm. Rooms not listed are mode none.

modes.code_owned: Only the room's own ASM calls RoomState_IsSolved / RoomState_MarkSolved.
modes.shutters_stay_open: When the room's tag opens the shutters, the room is marked solved; later loads start with shutters open (door slots 0-3) and skip the entry close. clear_tags lists tag slots (AE, AF) to clear on a solved load, for tags such as HoldDoor that rewrite the shutter state every frame.
